info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Update API enables organizations to modify existing syndicated loan details within trade banking. Utilizing the PATCH method, users can update specific parameters of a syndicated loan identified by {param1}. This API serves financial institutions and business users who require timely adjustments to loan agreements or terms in response to market conditions or client needs. It is designed to ensure efficient management of trade banking operations, enhancing the agility and responsiveness of financial services.

patch.summary: Update details of a specific syndicated loan.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify information related to a specific syndicated loan identified by its loan ID. Use this operation to update parameters like interest rates, payment schedules, or borrower details. Ensure all required fields are included in the request body for the update to succeed.
